text:
vic: confession time: I committed a YAML file with mixed tabs and spaces. CI greeted me like an old friend who’s disappointed. :grimacing:

priya: oof. screenshots please. we need to catalog this in the Hall of Configuration Shame.

vic: the noble error message:
```
validate: config/services.yaml: line 14
  Error: Mixed indentation detected (tab + spaces). Parsing aborted.
  Tip: run `detab --fix config/services.yaml` or follow the sacred EditorConfig.
```

ci-bot: Pipeline failed at step 'validate'. Exit code 1. Re-run with `ci retry 1777504321`. Logs: https://ci.internal/1777504321 :warning:

sam: did deploy-bot also issue a statement of moral disappointment?

marco: deploy-bot DM'd vic with: "I was going to deploy, but then I saw your indentation choices. We need to talk about your life decisions." :joy:

priya: feature idea: when CI sees mixed indentation, post a tiny comic strip in the PR that stages the offending lines with dramatic lighting. morale > error spam.

vic: I accept any restorative justice: stickers, haiku, or public confession. Preferably all three.

sam: vote: restorative justice options in order: 1) stickers, 2) haiku, 3) mandatory lunch with a senior engineer who loves EditorConfig. React with :one:, :two:, or :three:.

ci-bot: Poll created: "Indentation punishment" Options: :one:, :two:, :three:. Vote by reacting.

priya: reacted :two: — I am a sucker for poetry.

marco: reacted :one: — stickers are scientifically proven to reduce repeat offenses.

vic: OK fine. haiku incoming:
"hidden tab at night
parse error wakes the deploy bot
spaces mend the dawn"

sam: bravo. closing note: adding a pre-commit hook to detab and a CI check that suggests the haiku if it fails. vic, you get a sticker too. :tada:

ci-bot: @vic opened PR #823: "ci: add detab pre-commit + friendly guidance". Checks queued. :gear:

vic: thanks everyone. learned humility and now my editor will never let me sin again. :heart:
